# Freepod

> Private, EU-hosted apps for your photos, files, passwords and chats, and hosting for your own apps, deployed from source with the `freepod` command-line client.

## Deploying your own project

Install the client with any one of:

```bash
uv tool install freepod
pip install freepod
brew install erikvanzijst/tap/freepod
```

Add the skill that teaches your coding agent how to build and deploy for Freepod:

```bash
freepod skill install
```

`freepod login` needs a person at a browser. Then deploy from the project directory:

```bash
freepod login
freepod init
freepod deploy
```

- [Freepod for developers](https://freepod.eu/dev)
